question:
Which of the following numbers will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

17, 25, 37, 53, 73, 97, ?
solution:
**The logic followed here is:** Consecutive multiples of (4) starting with (8) are added.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/71ac8dafea34edf8c40c544bda1a9fe0e6b1a90e4a221c8fe82090c1bf117a4a.png] 

Hence, the correct option is "Option - (3)".
